item.text: {"action":"trial","proposal_id":"proposal-scheduling-prefix-budget-2048","agent_role":"batching","parent_trial_id":"trial-2","model_id":"Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct","changed_lever":"max_num_batched_tokens","proposed_value":2048,"evidence_used":["p95_latency_ms","trial_2_p95_latency_ms","trial_3_p95_latency_ms","trial_2_successful_requests","trial_3_successful_requests","trial_2_generation_errors","trial_3_generation_errors","trial_2_concurrency_8_cumulative_snapshot_mean_ttft_ms","trial_3_concurrency_8_cumulative_snapshot_mean_ttft_ms"],"predicted_metric_change":"With prefix caching retained and max_num_batched_tokens=2048, p95_latency_ms should remain below the baseline 769.4799790006073 ms and may improve over trial-2's 625.3724439993675 ms; quality and successful request counts should remain unchanged.","confidence":0.58,"expected_trial_cost":1,"falsification_condition":"Refute the hypothesis if p95_latency_ms is not at least 5% below baseline, exceeds trial-2_p95_latency_ms without a compensating measured benefit, quality falls below 0.99, generation_errors becomes nonzero, or trial-2_concurrency_8_cumulative_snapshot_mean_ttft_ms is not improved or maintained.","reason":"The observed issue was not an execution failure: trial-3 was collected with zero generation errors and passed quality, but its p95_latency_ms was 770.4907300012565 versus baseline p95_latency_ms of 769.4799790006073, so the objective did not improve.
